description: Machine-readable inventory of everything this repository deploys. `bin/dsh` reads this file; update it whenever an artifact is added or moved.

artifacts.notes: User-global instruction file. Loaded before every project AGENTS.md; the ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md copy is intentionally not used so the file stays tool-agnostic.
Compact rules 1-7 for subagent prompts. Not auto-loaded by DSH; AGENTS.md points to it and must be read on demand.
Each first-level directory becomes ~/.agents/skills/<name> -> repo. DSH ranks user-agents skills at 500, below project skills and above bundled skills.
The profile patch layer: models, UI, tool and agent settings. DSH and the Web Settings page also write this file, so run `bin/dsh capture` after changing settings in the app.
Profile bundles in dsh.profile.bundles (ordered, later wins) and third-party bundle dependencies.
pnpm settings for the profile (node linker, allowBuilds).

plugins.notes: Client-only Web bundle that pins workspaces to the top of the sidebar. Canonical source is this directory. Installed in the desktop profile as a link: dependency; `bin/dsh apply --with-plugins` links this directory on a target machine and selects the bundle. Restart DSH afterwards.

mcp.notes: MCP servers are plugin rows in the profile patch. servers.yaml is the human inventory that must stay in sync with it.
